description: INCIDENTI E PERSONE INFORTUNATE SULLE STRADE URBANE ED EXTRAURBANE ANNO is a series of datasets listed in Italian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Comune di Palermo. la tabella contiene i dati dell'anno 2011 riguardanti gli incidenti e le persone infortunate sulle strade urbane ed extraurbane suddividendoli per giorno della settimana e conseguenza dell'incidente. Coverage: Comune di Palermo. The portal lists 3 near-identical datasets in this series (one per year, month, area or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher Comune di Palermo. Its tags are incidenti, infortuni, strade-extraurbane, strade-urbane. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2025-11-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-it-portal.
